name: http-boundary
title: Check Authorized HTTP Boundary
description: Checks one explicit HTTP(S) endpoint from the machine running Magic Box. It records unauthenticated behavior and can optionally retry using a credential loaded only from an environment variable.

settings.name: url
settings.title: URL
settings.description: One explicit authorized http:// or https:// endpoint. Redirects are reported but not followed.

settings.name: method
settings.title: HTTP Method
settings.description: Safe read-only probe method: HEAD or GET. Defaults to HEAD; use GET when the target does not implement HEAD.

settings.name: authorized_target
settings.title: Authorized Target
settings.description: Confirm this target is yours or you are permitted to test.

settings.name: auth_env
settings.title: Credential Environment Variable
settings.description: Optional environment-variable name containing the credential. Never put the credential itself here.

settings.name: auth_header
settings.title: Auth Header
settings.description: Optional HTTP header name. Defaults to Authorization.

settings.name: auth_scheme
settings.title: Auth Scheme
settings.description: Optional prefix such as Bearer. Defaults to Bearer.

settings.name: auth_raw
settings.title: Raw Credential Header
settings.description: When true, sends the environment credential as the complete header value with no Bearer or other scheme prefix.

settings.name: expect_unauthenticated
settings.title: Expected Unauthenticated Result
settings.description: Optional expected classification: allowed, denied, redirected, not-found, other, or unreachable.

settings.name: expect_authenticated
settings.title: Expected Authenticated Result
settings.description: Optional expected classification when auth_env is available.

settings.name: timeout_ms
settings.title: Timeout (ms)
settings.description: Optional request timeout from 250 to 15000 milliseconds.
